hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in *.env.example|*.env.sample) ;; *.env|*.env.*) echo 'Blocked: editing .env files is not allowed (secrets live there). Edit .env.example instead.' >&2; exit 2;; esac
file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css) bunx @biomejs/biome check --write "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac
